summary.text: Derrick Hildebrant is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 23 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Republican primary was canceled, and he lists his profession as Bible translation consultant.

paragraphs.text: Derrick Hildebrant served in the U.S. Air National Guard from 1998 to 2024.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Oklahoma State University in 2008, two master's degrees from the Southern Baptist Theological Seminary in 2017 and 2023, and a Ph.D. from the same seminary in 2024.
His career experience includes working as a Bible translation consultant.
Hildebrant assumed office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Terry O'Donnell, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee.
